links.comparator_used: Same model without confidence thresholding (all predictions output, AUROC 0.840 in retrospective test set)
links.outcome: Diagnostic discrimination of ICCA vs metastasis (AUROC and false-positive rate) in the retrospective test set
links.effect: Confidence thresholding improved AUROC from 0.840 to 0.958 with an FPR of 0; prospective AUROCs 1.00 (French cohort) and 0.965 (Asian cohort)
links.tradeoff: Only 46% of samples retained for high-confidence prediction; the remainder is not predicted with confidence
links.quote: Implementation of confidence thresholding improved the AUROC to 0.958 with an FPR of 0, while retaining 46% of samples for high-confidence prediction.
